question: Who among the following wrote the book 'I am a Soldier's wife'?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Geetika Lidder**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Geetika Lidder** is the author of the book titled **'I am a Soldier's Wife'**.
 
• The book is a tribute to the life of soldiers and their families, focusing on the challenges faced by a soldier’s spouse.
 
• **Geetika Lidder** is known for her emotional and inspirational writing, bringing to light the sacrifices made by military families.
 
• The book is an example of **literary works that highlight the human side of military life**, emphasizing resilience and courage.
 
• **'I am a Soldier's Wife'** provides insights into the emotional aspects and the unspoken realities of being married to a soldier.
 
• The book has gained recognition for its **poignant and heartfelt storytelling**, making it relatable to readers who value stories of dedication and perseverance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Soumitra Chatterjee**__

 __
 
• **Soumitra Chatterjee** was a renowned actor from **India**, primarily known for his work in Bengali cinema.
 
• He collaborated extensively with **Satyajit Ray**, starring in iconic films like **'The World of Apu'**.
 
• Soumitra Chatterjee was awarded the **Dadasaheb Phalke Award**, India's highest award in cinema, for his contributions to Indian cinema.
 
 
 
• **Dr. Aishwarya Pandit**__
 __
 
• **Dr. Aishwarya Pandit** is a historian and academic known for her work in the field of Indian history and culture.
 
• She has contributed to research and publications on **Indian socio-political history**, but is not associated with the book **'I am a Soldier's Wife.'**
 
 
 
• **Namita Gokhale**__
 
 
• **Namita Gokhale** is an Indian writer and co-founder of the **Jaipur Literature Festival**.
 
• She is known for her novels like **'Paro: Dreams of Passion'** and **'The Himalayan Love Story.'**
 
• Her works often explore themes of **contemporary Indian society and mythology.**
